scope: Native iPhone real disposable cloud account: actual local reminder delivery, sign-out retirement of pending and delivered alerts, reentry with unchanged inspected task/reminder fields and only the future occurrence, native synthetic-task deletion and signed-out normal relaunch.
implementation: iOS-owned DEBUG-only registry inspection and native tests; release behavior and Mac code unchanged.

preservation.activityHistoryNote: Only task_activity changes across the two synthetic task create/delete walks; all other 13 checked tables, including the epoch, are exactly restored.

productCleanup.reason: Native runs terminal; installed app terminated; disposable Simulator shut down

limits: No account A → B, delayed notification callback, Mac action, APNs, physical-device or distribution pass.
Main workflow launches explicitly select cloud mode; the separate normal-relaunch test omits workspace/seed/session overrides.
The task comparison covers inspected ID/title/completion/plan/reminder fields; the server comparison independently covers all original workspace rows.
DEBUG inspection controls crowd the toolbar; these captures do not establish production toolbar visual acceptance.
Initial full run failed at cleanup because the task-details button was queried as StaticText; corrected native cleanup passed before the final full run.

environment.finalState: App terminated; disposable Simulator shut down; persisted localMode false; isolated cache pending queue empty; temporary tasks absent.

reproduce.build: xcodebuild build-for-testing -project <new-stage>/Taskfold.xcodeproj -scheme Taskfold -configuration Debug -destination platform=iOS Simulator,id=<disposable-phone> -derivedDataPath <fresh-cache> ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES ARCHS=arm64 DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=<team>
reproduce.fixtures: Private 0600 /private/tmp/taskfold-live-verification.json in its validated taskfold-continuity-<UUID>@example.invalid namespace. Supply a fresh UUID TASKFOLD_REMINDER_ACCOUNT_NONCE in the XCTest runner EnvironmentVariables. Never use --uitesting or seed flags for the authenticated journey.
reproduce.signing: Use owned sign_simulator_test_products.py with widgetstatetests allowlist and verify_widget_catalog.py --require-team before native execution.
reproduce.cleanupRecovery: The separately scoped testCleanupAuthenticatedReminderAfterInterruptedWalk uses the same nonce and an already authenticated isolated app; it must not be run against unrelated task data.
